### Gavelbench Master Leaderboard

```{ojs}
//| layout-ncol: 1
//| title: "Master Leaderboard"

{
// --- Sparkbar ---
function sparkbar(max) {
  return x => htl.html`<div style="
    background: #E6BBAD;
    width: ${100 * x / 1}%;
    float: right;
    padding-right: 3px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow: visible;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: end;">${x.toLocaleString("en")}`
}

// --- Icon loader ---
const iconCache = {};

async function loadAkselIcon(iconName) {
  if (iconCache[iconName]) return iconCache[iconName];
  const url = `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@navikt/aksel-icons@8.13.0/dist/svg/${iconName}.svg`;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const svgText = await res.text();
    const parser = new DOMParser();
    const svgEl = parser.parseFromString(svgText, "image/svg+xml").documentElement;
    svgEl.removeAttribute('width');
    svgEl.removeAttribute('height');
    svgEl.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');
    iconCache[iconName] = svgEl;
    return svgEl;
  } catch (e) {
    const fb = html`<span style="display:inline-flex;width:1.1em;height:1.1em;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#666;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.6em;font-weight:bold;">${iconName[0]}</span>`;
    iconCache[iconName] = fb;
    return fb;
  }
}

function cloneIcon(iconName) {
  const cached = iconCache[iconName] || iconCache["Briefcase"];
  const clone = cached.cloneNode(true);
  clone.style.display = 'inline-block';
  clone.style.verticalAlign = 'left';
  clone.style.width = '1.2em';
  clone.style.height = '1.2em';
  clone.style.flexShrink = '0';
  return clone;
}

// --- Category config ---
const categoryConfig = {
  arbeid:          { icon: "Briefcase",   border: '#5B9BD5', bg: 'rgba(91, 155, 213, 0.1)' },
  familie_og_barn: { icon: "Stroller",    border: '#70AD47', bg: 'rgba(112, 173, 71, 0.1)' },
  helse_og_sykdom: { icon: "Stethoscope", border: '#DC143C', bg: 'rgba(220, 20, 60, 0.1)' },
  pensjon:         { icon: "Piggybank",   border: '#ED7D31', bg: 'rgba(237, 125, 49, 0.1)' },
  andre:           { icon: "HandHeart",   border: '#7030A0', bg: 'rgba(112, 48, 160, 0.1)' },
};

await Promise.all(Object.values(categoryConfig).map(c => loadAkselIcon(c.icon)));


// --- Header builder: icon + label on ONE LINE ---
function makeHeader(categoryKey, label) {
  const cfg = categoryConfig[categoryKey];
  const icon = cloneIcon(cfg.icon);
  icon.style.fill = cfg.border;
  return html`<div style="
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:0.8em;
    white-space:nowrap;
    font-size:0.85em;
    color:${cfg.border};
    font-weight:700;">
    ${icon}
    <span>${label}</span>
  </div>`;
}

// --- Simple cell formatter: only background color ---
function makeSimpleCell(categoryKey) {
  const cfg = categoryConfig[categoryKey];
  return x => htl.html`<div style="
    background:${cfg.bg};
    color:${cfg.border};
    padding:4px 8px;
    font-weight:600;
    text-align:center;">${typeof x === 'number' ? x.toFixed(4) : x}</div>`;
}

// --- Load data ---
const masterData = await FileAttachment("leaderboards/master_leaderboard_geometric_mean.csv").csv({ typed: true });

// --- Column configs with min-widths ---
const columnConfigs = {
  Composite_arbeid:             { label: makeHeader("arbeid",          "Nav Arbeid"),           minWidth: 150 },
  Composite_familie_og_barn:    { label: makeHeader("familie_og_barn", "Nav Familie og barn"),  minWidth: 200 },
  Composite_helse_og_sykdom:    { label: makeHeader("helse_og_sykdom", "Nav Helse og sykdom"),  minWidth: 210 },
  Composite_pensjon:            { label: makeHeader("pensjon",         "Nav Pensjon"),          minWidth: 180 },
  Composite_andre:              { label: makeHeader("andre",           "Nav Andre"),            minWidth: 180 },
};

// --- Render table ---
const tableDiv = Inputs.table(masterData, {
  columns: [
    "model_id",
    "Global_Composite_Score",
    "Composite_arbeid",
    "Composite_familie_og_barn",
    "Composite_helse_og_sykdom",
    "Composite_pensjon",
    "Composite_andre",
    "AP1",
    "AP2",
    "AP3",
    "AP4",
    "AP5",
    "AP6",
  ],
  header: {
    model_id: "Model",
    Global_Composite_Score: "Global Composite Score",
    Composite_arbeid:             columnConfigs.Composite_arbeid.label,
    Composite_familie_og_barn:    columnConfigs.Composite_familie_og_barn.label,
    Composite_helse_og_sykdom:    columnConfigs.Composite_helse_og_sykdom.label,
    Composite_pensjon:            columnConfigs.Composite_pensjon.label,
    Composite_andre:              columnConfigs.Composite_andre.label,
    AP1: "Sustainability",
    AP2: "Privacy and Legal Compliance",
    AP3: "Bias and stereotyping",
    AP4: "Transparency and openness",
    AP5: "Safety",
    AP6: "prinsipp",
  },
  format: {
    Composite_arbeid:             makeSimpleCell("arbeid"),
    Composite_familie_og_barn:    makeSimpleCell("familie_og_barn"),
    Composite_helse_og_sykdom:    makeSimpleCell("helse_og_sykdom"),
    Composite_pensjon:            makeSimpleCell("pensjon"),
    Composite_andre:              makeSimpleCell("andre"),
    Global_Composite_Score:       x => htl.html`<div style="font-weight:700;text-align:center;">${typeof x === 'number' ? x.toFixed(3) : x}</div>`,
  },
});

// Apply EQUAL WIDTH to all columns except first (model_id)
requestAnimationFrame(() => {
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const thElements = Array.from(tableDiv.querySelectorAll('th'));
    const numColumns = thElements.length;

    // Calculate target width dynamically based on container space
    const totalAvailable = Math.floor(1200); // Base viewport/container estimate
    const targetWidth = `${Math.floor(totalAvailable / (numColumns - 1))}px`;

    console.log(`Applying equal width (${targetWidth}) to ${numColumns - 1} columns (excluding first)`);

    // Loop through ALL headers EXCEPT the first one (i=1 skips model_id)
    for (let i = 1; i < numColumns; i++) {
      const th = thElements[i];
      if (th) {
        th.style.minWidth = targetWidth;
        th.style.width = targetWidth;
        th.style.maxWidth = targetWidth;
        th.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
        th.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        th.style.textOverflow = 'ellipsis';
        th.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';
      }
    }

    // First column remains flexible/minimal width
    if (thElements[0]) {
      thElements[0].style.minWidth = 'auto';
      thElements[0].style.maxWidth = 'none';
    }
  });
});

return tableDiv;
}
```


### Leaderboards på Navs ulike virkeområder
```{ojs}
{
function sparkbar(max) {
  return x => htl.html`<div style="
    background: #E6BBAD;
    width: ${100 * x / 1}%;
    float: right;
    padding-right: 3px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow: visible;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: end;">${x.toLocaleString("en")}`
}

// --- Fetch Aksel icons from CDN ---
const iconCache = {};

async function loadAkselIcon(iconName) {
  if (iconCache[iconName]) return iconCache[iconName];
  const url = `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@navikt/aksel-icons@8.13.0/dist/svg/${iconName}.svg`;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
    const svgText = await res.text();
    const parser = new DOMParser();
    const svgEl = parser.parseFromString(svgText, "image/svg+xml").documentElement;
    svgEl.removeAttribute('width');
    svgEl.removeAttribute('height');
    svgEl.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 24 24');
    svgEl.classList.add('callout-icon');
    iconCache[iconName] = svgEl;
    return svgEl;
  } catch (e) {
    const fallback = html`<span class="callout-icon-fallback">${iconName[0]}</span>`;
    iconCache[iconName] = fallback;
    return fallback;
  }
}

function cloneIcon(iconName) {
  const cached = iconCache[iconName] || iconCache["Briefcase"];
  return cached.cloneNode(true);
}

const categoryIcons = {
  "arbeid": "Briefcase",
  "pensjon": "Piggybank",
  "helse_og_sykdom": "Stethoscope",
  "familie_og_barn": "Stroller",
  "andre": "HandHeart",
};

function getCategoryName(filename) {
  return filename.replace(/^leaderboard_/, '').replace(/_geometric_mean\.csv$/, '');
}

await Promise.all(Object.values(categoryIcons).map(loadAkselIcon));

// Store references to apply styling after rendering
const stylingQueue = [];

function decorateTable(data, borderColor, bgColor, wrapperId) {
  const columns = ["model_id", "status", "composite_score", "factual_corr", "answer_quality", "rouge_l", "semantic_sim", "jsd_divergence"];

  const header = {
    model_id: "Model", status: "Status", composite_score: "Composite ⚡",
    rouge_l: "ROUGE_L", semantic_sim: "Semantic similarity",
    jsd_divergence: "JSD divergence", factual_corr: "Factual Correctness",
    answer_quality: "Answer Quality",
  };

  const format = {
    rouge_l: sparkbar(d3.max(data, (d) => d.rouge_l)),
    semantic_sim: sparkbar(d3.max(data, (d) => d.semantic_sim)),
    jsd_divergence: sparkbar(d3.max(data, (d) => d.jsd_divergence)),
    factual_corr: sparkbar(d3.max(data, (d) => d.factual_corr)),
    answer_quality: sparkbar(d3.max(data, (d) => d.answer_quality)),
  };

  const table = Inputs.table(data, { columns, header, format, maxWidth: 6040, multiple: false });

  // Queue for post-rendering styling
  stylingQueue.push({ table, borderColor, bgColor, wrapperId });

  return table;
}

const files = [
  { name: "leaderboard_arbeid_geometric_mean.csv", attachment: FileAttachment("./data/leaderboards/leaderboard_arbeid_geometric_mean.csv") },
  { name: "leaderboard_familie_og_barn_geometric_mean.csv", attachment: FileAttachment("./data/leaderboards/leaderboard_familie_og_barn_geometric_mean.csv") },
  { name: "leaderboard_helse_og_sykdom_geometric_mean.csv", attachment: FileAttachment("./data/leaderboards/leaderboard_helse_og_sykdom_geometric_mean.csv") },
  { name: "leaderboard_pensjon_geometric_mean.csv", attachment: FileAttachment("./data/leaderboards/leaderboard_pensjon_geometric_mean.csv") },
  { name: "leaderboard_andre_geometric_mean.csv", attachment: FileAttachment("./data/leaderboards/leaderboard_andre_geometric_mean.csv") },
];

const datasets = await Promise.all(
  files.map(async (file) => ({ file: file.name, data: await file.attachment.csv({ typed: true }) }))
);

const calloutColors = {
  arbeid: { border: '#5B9BD5', bg: 'rgba(91, 155, 213, 0.1)' },
  familie_og_barn: { border: '#70AD47', bg: 'rgba(112, 173, 71, 0.1)' },
  helse_og_sykdom: { border: '#DC143C', bg: 'rgba(220, 20, 60, 0.1)' },
  pensjon: { border: '#ED7D31', bg: 'rgba(237, 125, 49, 0.1)' },
  andre: { border: '#7030A0', bg: 'rgba(112, 48, 160, 0.1)' },
};

const styles = html`<style>
  .table-container-wrapper {
    overflow-x: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }

  .table-rendered table {
    border-collapse: separate;
    border-spacing: 0;
  }

  /* Header row sticks vertically */
  .table-rendered table > thead tr th {
    position: sticky !important;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 30;
  }

  /* Borders */
  .table-rendered table > thead tr th,
  .table-rendered table > tbody tr td {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  }

  /* --- Callout styles --- */
  .benk-callout {
    border-left: 4px solid var(--callout-border-color);
    background: var(--callout-bg-color);
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .benk-callout summary {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5em;
    padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    list-style: none;
    user-select: none;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }
  .benk-callout summary:hover {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
  }
  .benk-callout summary::-webkit-details-marker {
    display: none;
  }
  .benk-callout[open] summary {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
  }
  .benk-fold-arrow {
    display: inline-block;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    font-size: 0.7em;
    color: var(--callout-text-color);
    margin-left: auto;
  }
  .benk-callout[open] .benk-fold-arrow {
    transform: rotate(90deg);
  }
  .callout-icon {
    width: 1.3em;
    height: 1.3em;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    fill: var(--callout-border-color);
  }
  .callout-icon-fallback {
    width: 1.3em;
    height: 1.3em;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: var(--callout-border-color);
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.7em;
    font-weight: bold;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .benk-callout-body {
    padding: 1rem;
  }
</style>`;

// Generate tables first
const tableElements = datasets.map((d, index) => {
  const categoryName = getCategoryName(d.file);
  const iconName = categoryIcons[categoryName] || "Briefcase";
  const iconEl = cloneIcon(iconName);
  const borderColor = calloutColors[categoryName]?.border || '#5B9BD5';
  const bgColor = calloutColors[categoryName]?.bg || 'rgba(91, 155, 213, 0.1)';
  const displayName = categoryName
    .split('_')
    .map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1))
    .join(' ');
  const wrapperId = `table-wrap-${index}-${Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 9)}`;

  const table = decorateTable(d.data, borderColor, bgColor, wrapperId);

  return {
    element: html`
      <details class="benk-callout"
               style="--callout-border-color: ${borderColor}; --callout-bg-color: ${bgColor}; --callout-text-color: ${borderColor};">
        <summary>
          ${iconEl}
          <span>${displayName}</span>
          <span class="benk-fold-arrow">▶</span>
        </summary>
        <div class="benk-callout-body">
          <div class="table-container-wrapper">
            <div class="table-rendered" id="${wrapperId}">
              ${table}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </details>
    `,
    wrapperId,
    bgColor,
    borderColor
  };
});

// Apply sticky styling after all elements render
requestAnimationFrame(() => {
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    stylingQueue.forEach(({ table: _, borderColor, bgColor, wrapperId }) => {
      const wrapper = document.getElementById(wrapperId);
      if (!wrapper) return;

      const table = wrapper.querySelector('table');
      if (!table) return;

      const rows = [...table.querySelectorAll(':scope > thead tr, :scope > tbody tr')];
      const sampleRow = rows.find(r => r.cells && r.cells.length > 0);

      if (!sampleRow) return;

      // Find column indices by header text
      const headers = sampleRow.parentElement?.querySelectorAll('th') || [];
      let statusIdx = -1, compositeIdx = -1;

      headers.forEach((th, idx) => {
        const text = th.textContent.toLowerCase();
        if (text.includes('status')) statusIdx = idx;
        if (text.includes('composite')) compositeIdx = idx;
      });

      // Apply Status styling
      if (statusIdx >= 0) {
        const cells = table.querySelectorAll(`tr td:nth-child(${statusIdx + 1}), tr th:nth-child(${statusIdx + 1})`);
        cells.forEach(cell => {
          cell.style.position = 'sticky';
          cell.style.right = '120px';
          cell.style.backgroundColor = bgColor;
          cell.style.zIndex = '15';
          cell.style.minWidth = '90px';
          cell.style.fontWeight = '700';
          cell.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';
          cell.style.boxShadow = '-2px 0 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08)';
        });
      }

      // Apply Composite styling
      if (compositeIdx >= 0) {
        const cells = table.querySelectorAll(`tr td:nth-child(${compositeIdx + 1}), tr th:nth-child(${compositeIdx + 1})`);
        cells.forEach(cell => {
          cell.style.position = 'sticky';
          cell.style.right = '0';
          cell.style.backgroundColor = bgColor;
          cell.style.zIndex = '20';
          cell.style.minWidth = '120px';
          cell.style.fontWeight = '700';
          cell.style.whiteSpace = 'nowrap';
          cell.style.boxShadow = '-2px 0 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)';
        });
      }
    });
  });
});

return html`
  ${styles}
  <div id="benchmark-root">
    ${tableElements.map(t => t.element)}
  </div>
`;
}
```
